summary: Changing the wrapper selection to physical GPU 0 did not change the actual device because the global Accelerate gpu_ids setting still routed to physical GPU 2; model load OOM repeated.
evidence: gpu-lease.json recorded physical GPU 0 with 63,710 MiB free while the OOM again named the two processes occupying physical GPU 2.
lessons: The launcher command must be independent of user-level Accelerate defaults.
limitations: No optimization step or checkpoint was produced.
next_actions: Add explicit gpu_ids and a single-process Accelerate configuration.
